blurb:
Discover the flavors of paradise on our Key West food tour through the colorful streets of Old Town. Guided by locals, you’ll enjoy 5+ tastings that celebrate the island’s unique mix of Cuban, Caribbean, and Floridian influences. Start with a refreshing iced coffee before biting into golden, crispy conch fritters—a true island classic. Savor authentic Cuban cuisine that reflects Key West’s cultural heritage, then indulge in rich chocolate-covered Key lime pie, the city’s most famous dessert. Along the way, your guide will share stories of pirates, poets, and island life, bringing the history and charm of Key West to life. To end, you’ll taste our exclusive Secret Dish, a surprise that makes the experience truly unforgettable. This is Key West beyond the postcard—an authentic taste of its food, culture, and soul.

As a private tour, everything works around you! Our start times are much more easy going, dates can open up. It's a much more intimate and cozy experience.
